steps.text: The server runs The Boogler’s brain at 10 Hz while the room is awake. It decides a new leg when his intent changes.
One replicated leg reaches every tab. Each computes his pose from that leg and the room clock, without steady walking packets.
Talk and ride are Owner facts. Presents and puffs are server commands; accepted reactions reach friends, while the presser sees the prediction immediately.
No tab runs his shared decisions. A tab closing or hiding leaves the server in charge. Prototype pages keep a local Boogler per tab and local, unarbitrated seats.
